rows.title: Nuclear History Quest
rows.description: Battle through the history of nuclear science! Defeat monsters by answering questions about key discoveries and milestones.

boss.name: Nuclear History King
boss.defeatMessage: The History King crowns you as a nuclear scholar!

rows.title: Radiation Discovery Maze
rows.description: Battle through radiation fundamentals! Defeat monsters by mastering the basics of atoms, isotopes, and radiation types.

boss.name: Radiation Lord
boss.defeatMessage: The Radiation Lord bows to your atomic knowledge!

rows.title: Reactor Technology Challenge
rows.description: Battle through reactor technology! Defeat monsters by mastering how nuclear reactors work, from fuel to safety systems.

boss.name: Reactor Overlord
boss.defeatMessage: The Reactor Overlord powers down! You are a true nuclear engineer!

rows.title: The Safety Labyrinth
rows.description: Battle through nuclear safety challenges! Defeat monsters by answering questions about reactor safety, containment, and emergency procedures.

boss.name: Safety Guardian
boss.defeatMessage: The Safety Guardian bows to your nuclear knowledge!
